detection_rules.name: Multiple Failed PIN Attempts (Brute Force)
detection_rules.description: Triggered when 5 or more consecutive invalid PIN entries occur within 5 minutes on the same card or terminal.

detection_rules.name: High-Value Transaction Anomaly
detection_rules.description: Triggered when a requested cash withdrawal exceeds 4x the customer's typical statistical baseline.

detection_rules.name: ATM Physical Tamper Breach
detection_rules.description: Zero-tolerance alarm triggered when physical cabinet, door, or tilt sensors indicate chassis breach.

detection_rules.name: API Rate Limit & Burst Abuse
detection_rules.description: Triggered when incoming HTTP transaction requests from a single client IP exceed maximum threshold.
